summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running any code or tests, and nothing is committed. Added src/textual/widgets/_tabs.py with a Tabs widget: padded labels above an UnderlineBar that highlights the active tab's full span; left/right keys cycle with wrap-around; digits 1-9 activate tabs by position; letter keys search labels cyclically; clicks on either row activate the nearest tab. Exported Tabs from src/textual/widgets/__init__.py, added sandbox/tabs.py as a demo, and added an Unreleased entry to CHANGELOG.md. Verification was by reading only. Choices to review: no message is posted on tab change (watch active_tab instead), digit 0 is ignored, and no tests were added.
